metadata.title: Alphabet Earnings Preview: Will Doubling AI Capex Pay Off for GOOGL Stock?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Alphabet Kicks Off Mag 7 Earnings, and It’s Going to Be an AI Spending Palooza
Alphabet will report earnings Wednesday, and Wall Street expects capital spending to double as the company builds the infrastructure needed to power artificial intelligence.
